expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner uses white text on a very light mint green background, producing extremely low contrast for both the headline and the subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10'), making it hard to read.

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut off flush at the screen edge with its title truncated and no ellipsis or peek gutter, so it reads as broken rather than scrollable.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip with no visual affordance that it scrolls.
The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20%) is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or bottom padding, making the list look truncated.
Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circle with dark outline on the ramen card, dark circle with white outline on the pizza card.
The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while sibling cards use dark imagery, so the row looks visually unbalanced and its white time badge nearly blends in.
Section 'See all' links sit very close to the clipped card edge and the third card's delivery text ('€1.90 delivery') is also cut, giving an unfinished appearance.
